Subject: Mutual action checklist, phase gates, and owner runbook (initial MAP)

Hi Ellen —

Great to speak yesterday. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that breaks the onboarding into three phase gates and calls out primary owners on both sides. High level:

- Phase A (Prep): account provisioning, security intake, and SSO test accounts — target: 2 weeks
- Phase B (Integration): model selection, test prompts, and sandbox traffic — target: 3 weeks
- Phase C (Go-live): performance validation, runbook drills, and cutover — target: 1 week

Key asks for Ferrum: a named network contact for VPC peering (if going private), and a list of 10 priority prompts for quality validation.

I attached Ferrum_MAP_v1.xlsx and a draft SOW for pricing context (SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf). Please review the owners column and let us know:

1) Any changes to owners or contacts by end of day Friday
2) Any timing constraints (e.g., blackout dates in late May)

Next steps from our side: Ben will scope the sandbox capacity and Marcus will propose a test cadence for KV cache warmup.

Thanks — looking forward to a quick sign-off so we can schedule the kickoff.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Ferrum_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets); SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf (PDF, 7 pages)
